_comment: Copy this to profile.json and fill in what applies. profile.json is gitignored.
Keys are the canonical field names the fill plan prints in its MAPPED TO column,
so when a field reports a gap, the plan tells you which key to add here.
Delete any key you would rather answer by hand; an absent key is simply reported.
Values here can answer questions the engine otherwise refuses to touch, such as
work authorization or desired salary. That is intentional: the tool will not
invent an answer to a legal declaration, but an answer you wrote yourself is
your own. The plan marks these 'From your profile.' so it stays visible.
